ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact of the Trump administration's hold on Medicaid funds.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How has the Trump administration's hold on Medicaid funds affected vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for greater transparency and accountability in the administration of Medicaid funds.
